summaries.Romania: Romania faces economic contraction with EU predicting -0.3% GDP decline in 2026, while state-owned companies hemorrhage €1B annually and administrative reforms remain contentious political territory. Energy infrastructure improvements continue with nuclear restarts and gas network expansions offsetting these economic headwinds.
summaries.Healthcare: US loses measles elimination status amid vaccine hesitancy while FDA leadership transitions create uncertainty; meanwhile innovation accelerates with AI-driven care coordination, GLP-1 affordability programs, and gene therapy advances for blood disorders gaining momentum.
summaries.Tech: Apple services suffered major outages today while facing SEC investigation into Nvidia's Jensen Huang over alleged Chinese spy affair; the broader sector sees continued AI consolidation with OpenAI's GPT-6.2 release and Anthropic's IPO positioning major players for dominance.

items.title: Comisia Europeană prognozează recesiune în România în 2026. Date din prognoza de toamnă: PIB-ul se va contracta cu 0,3% în acest an/ deficit de 6% și inflație de 7,9%
items.snippet: PIB-ul real al României se va contracta în acest an cu aproximativ 0,3%, arată prognoza de toamnă a Comisiei Europene. Economia țării ar urma să accelereze la 1,8% și 2% în 2027, respectiv 2028. Noua prognoză indică o deteriorare a perspectivelor economice față de precedentele estimări. Conform prog
items.line: EU Commission predicts Romania will contract 0.3% in 2026 with 7.9% inflation, marking a critical inflection point requiring immediate fiscal reform.

items.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status, marking embarrassing stain on its public health record
items.snippet: Measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S., a finding that was expected but that marks an embarrassing backslide in the country’s basic public health standing.
items.line: US loses measles elimination status for first time, signaling public health emergency driven by vaccine hesitancy and political erosion of disease prevention infrastructure.

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.snippet: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
items.line: Nvidia projects record revenue despite Jensen Huang's exit over alleged Chinese spy affair, signaling market confidence in company's AI dominance trajectory.

items.title: Neacșu: Patru companii de stat au acumulat 90% din pierderile înregistrate în 2024. Datoriile societăților ajung la 18 miliarde de lei
items.snippet: Vicepremierul Marian Neacșu anunță reformarea companiilor de stat, după ce pierderile acumulate de acestea au ajuns la sume importante. Potrivit oficialului, cele 165 de societăți aflate la nivel central au înregistrat, în 2024, pierderi de aproximativ un miliard de euro, iar patru dintre ele au fos
items.line: Four state companies account for 90% of €1B annual losses across Romania's 165 state enterprises, exposing systemic management failures requiring urgent restructuring.

items.title: STAT+: With $173 million, new startup takes aim at sickle cell
items.snippet: Researchers are seeking a sickle cell treatment as effective as gene therapy, without the drawbacks. This entrepreneur thinks he might have one.
items.line: New $173M startup targets sickle cell disease with non-gene-therapy approach, addressing accessibility gaps in existing treatments.

items.title: HLTH 2026: Calibrate, Withings study finds wraparound care boosts GLP-1 weight loss by more than 60%
items.snippet: A two-year real-world study from Withings Health Solutions and Calibrate Health suggests that pairing GLP-1 medications with Calibrate’s integrated obesity care program produced substantially greater weight loss than GLP-1 treatment alone.
items.line: Real-world study shows wraparound care plus GLP-1 boosts weight loss >60%, establishing care model economics for obesity treatment.

items.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
items.snippet: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
items.line: SEC investigating Nvidia following CEO resignation involving foreign intelligence contact, raising governance and national security questions.

items.title: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage
items.snippet: Apple's status page confirms its services are facing outages, but has not confirmed the cause.
items.line: Apple iCloud, App Store, and Music services experience major outage affecting millions, blamed on internal update rather than cyberattack.

items.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
items.snippet: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
items.line: Amazon and Google combined will own ~29% of Anthropic post-IPO, concentrating AI power among tech giants and raising antitrust concerns.

items.title: Noul Guvern vine în ajutorul Dacia și Ford. Luca Niculescu a cerut măsuri de sprijin
items.snippet: Premierul Luca Niculescu a cerut miniștrilor implicați să identifice măsuri de sprijinire a industriei auto românești, cu accent pe situația uzinelor Dacia și Ford, au declarat pentru Profit.ro surse guvernamentale. Citiți mai mult pe Profit.ro.
items.line: Government pledges support for Dacia and Ford amid broader industrial competitiveness concerns in a contracting economy.

items.title: HLTH 2026: GLP-1 costs remain a challenge. A new CVS study aims to identify the right price
items.snippet: Cost and access to GLP-1s remains a challenge, but the benefits of these drugs aren't in doubt. A new study from CVS Health aims to quantify at what price a GLP-1 drug has generated enough savings elsewhere through improved clinical outcomes.
items.line: CVS health launches pricing study for GLP-1 drugs to identify cost-benefit threshold, addressing access barriers.

items.title: Probleme la Apple: Music, Apple Pay, App Store, iCloud și alte servicii, afectate de o întrerupere majoră. Ce spune compania
items.snippet: Multe dintre serviciile online ale Apple au suferit o întrerupere majoră, potrivit raportărilor utilizatorilor.Apple Music, App Store și alte servicii iCloud au fost afectate de aceste probleme tehnice, iar unii utilizatori au semnalat, de asemenea, probleme cu Apple Pay. items.line: Apple Music, Pay, and iCloud services disrupted in widespread outage, impacting ecosystem reliability.
